purpose: Profile GOLD gw_source_payloads content and relation to captures without returning full payload bodies
sql: SELECT p.payload_type,COUNT(*) rows_count,ROUND(SUM(COALESCE(OCTET_LENGTH(p.payload_text),0)+COALESCE(OCTET_LENGTH(CAST(p.payload_json AS CHAR)),0))/1024/1024,2) logical_mb,ROUND(AVG(COALESCE(OCTET_LENGTH(p.payload_text),0)+COALESCE(OCTET_LENGTH(CAST(p.payload_json AS CHAR)),0))/1024,2) avg_kb,ROUND(MAX(COALESCE(OCTET_LENGTH(p.payload_text),0)+COALESCE(OCTET_LENGTH(CAST(p.payload_json AS CHAR)),0))/1024,2) max_kb,SUM(p.payload_text IS NOT NULL) text_rows,SUM(p.payload_json IS NOT NULL) json_rows,COUNT(DISTINCT p.payload_hash) distinct_hashes FROM gw_source_payloads p GROUP BY p.payload_type ORDER BY logical_mb DESC
